metadata.description: Plugins by thebedcoder — structured SDLC workflows for Claude Code

plugins.name: agentic-engineering
plugins.description: Full SDLC agentic engineering workflow with named specialist agents — research, PRD, stories, implementation, 6-agent parallel review, end-user docs

plugins.name: jtbd
plugins.description: Jobs to Be Done megaskill — product brief to research, personas, competitor analysis, landing page copy, and platform-native ad scripts, powered by 5 parallel specialist agents

plugins.name: smart-setup
plugins.description: Project-tailored Claude Code setup — scans or interviews a project, sizes it into a tier, then generates right-sized Skills, Memory, Agents, Rules, Tools, and a workflow phase map behind a manifest approval gate.

plugins.name: squash-merge
plugins.description: Squash-merge the current branch into a target branch — clean preconditions, a Conventional Commit message synthesized from the squashed commits, and a post-merge push/delete prompt. Nothing pushed or deleted without an explicit choice.

plugins.name: update-dependencies
plugins.description: Audit and upgrade project dependencies on any stack — security advisories first, then patch/minor in a verified wave, then majors one at a time behind approval with changelog and migration steps.
